danger.title: Delete my account
danger.body: Permanently removes your profile, CV files, saved opportunities and settings. Alerts stop immediately. This can't be undone.

notifications.bellHint: Always on — the notifications panel in the header
notifications.keepOne: Keep at least one channel on so alerts can reach you.

rule.rule_new_match_hint: As soon as an opportunity scores above your threshold
rule.rule_deadline_reminders_hint: 3 days before a saved opportunity closes
rule.rule_application_updates_hint: Status changes, receipts and organizer replies
rule.rule_weekly_digest_hint: One summary email on Monday morning
rule.rule_profile_tips_hint: Suggestions to improve matching (at most once a week)

notifications.rulesLater: Alerts start once matching launches; your choices are saved now.
notifications.frequencyHint: How often match alerts are sent
notifications.bundleHint: Combine alerts into 1–2 batches instead of one message each
notifications.testHint: Send a sample message to check your channels
notifications.noMarketing: Alerts are about your opportunities only — never marketing

privacy.uploaded: {kind} · uploaded {date} · private storage, deleted on request
privacy.confirmDelete: Delete {name}? Your profile stays as it is.
privacy.exportHint: Profile, saved opportunities and uploaded-file details as one JSON file
privacy.retentionHint: Auto-delete submitted application records after this period

consent.agent_matching: Use my profile to judge eligibility
consent.agent_matching_hint: Your profile answers and CV fields are sent to the AI model to score opportunities. Turning this off turns matching off.
consent.ai_drafts_hint: The agent may write drafts; you review every answer before anything is submitted. Nothing sends automatically.
consent.chat_history: Remember my chat history with the agent
consent.chat_history_hint: Kept 90 days, visible only to you · clear it anytime from Ask the agent
consent.anonymized_stats_hint: Anonymous match statistics only — never your name, CV or answers. Off by default.

privacy.matchingOff: Matching is off: your agent won't score opportunities until you turn this back on.
privacy.sourcesHint: Public pages from universities, organisations and event sites. No social-media scraping.
privacy.providerHint: AI features (CV reading, matching, the agent) use the Google Gemini API, only for the features you turn on above.
privacy.formsHint: When the apply assistant launches, a form is filled only in your session. Organizers see their normal form and your answers.

agent.intro: Scanning starts when the matching agent goes live. Your choices here are saved now and applied from the first scan.

agent.eligibilityHint: Runs when a new opportunity appears
agent.autoSaveHint: ≥ 85% is saved automatically so nothing expires unseen
agent.draftsHint: Pre-fills drafts you can review — but never submits anything without your press
agent.submitHint: Off permanently — submission always needs a human. This can't be enabled.
